extension.description: A configurable video add-on for Kodi. Browse categories, search, keep favorites and a resume-aware watch history, and play from a content source you configure. Content-source agnostic: point it at your own JSON API or HTML source.
extension.news: v1.1.7 - Manage sources: add/rename/remove/switch named content sources (each optionally static) from a new root-menu screen, not just switch between already-configured ones. Fixed rename_source silently never persisting. Multiple subtitle tracks: a stream can carry one URL per language (subtitles list), not just a single subtitle URL. Static sources can now search (an optional pre-baked search-index.json, fetched once and filtered client-side). New tools/build_static_source.py turns a folder of your own videos into a static source -- no server, no account. repo/zips/**/*.zip rebuilds are now byte-identical when nothing changed (no more every-rebuild zip churn in diffs). v1.1.6 - Fixed the Settings -> Base API URL field, which was silently disconnected from every request (any source you typed there was ignored; only a source added via the multi-source manager ever worked). Fixed the Switch source menu item crashing on every use. Added a "static (no server)" content source mode, so a Kodi repository alone (GitHub Pages, any plain file host -- no code to run, no computer to keep on) can serve a working demo catalogue; see tools/build_static_demo.py. v1.1.5 - Five features added: resume badges with progress percentage in video listings (Progress, ResumeLabel properties); Trakt.tv scrobbling to track watch progress across devices (trakt_id on videos, trakt_enabled/username/token settings); subtitle URL passing on streams (subtitle field on Stream, setSubtitles); watch progress percentage in listings; and a content source switcher (multiple sources in sources.json, Switch source action). v1.1.4 - Preview images: videos may now include an optional "preview" URL (a still or animated frame). When provided it is shown as the listing's fanart/background image so the video content is identifiable at a glance; "thumb" remains the poster thumbnail.

extension.summary: Install and update the Cumnation add-on
extension.description: Repository for the Cumnation video add-on. Add this to receive Cumnation and its updates directly inside Kodi.
extension.news: v1.0.1 - Update URLs (info/checksum/datadir) now point at GitHub Pages instead of raw.githubusercontent.com. Raw GitHub still works for individual files (nothing breaks for anyone on 1.0.0), but Pages doesn't encode the branch name into the URL, so a future default-branch rename won't strand already-installed clients' updates the way changing `main` in a raw URL would.
